title: Variable bound of a cons formula
statement: For every clause $C$ of natural-number-indexed literals and every CNF formula $\varphi$ with such indices, the variable count of the formula with first clause $C$ and remaining clauses $\varphi$ is the maximum of the clause variable maximum of $C$ and the variable count of $\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a clause of natural-number-indexed literals
$\varphi$ is a CNF formula with natural-number variable indices
replaced:
The variable bound of a formula with first clause $C$ and remaining clauses
$\varphi$ equals the maximum of the clause variable maximum of $C$ with the
variable bound of $\varphi$.
